Job Details:
Job Description:
As an Information Technology Undergraduate Intern, you will play a vital role in supporting Intel's IT operations and solutions. You will be actively involved in hands-on projects, collaborating with cross-functional teams to solve real-world challenges and improve processes. Your contributions will help enhance technological efficiencies and support the development of innovative solutions that drive business performance.
Global IT is dedicated to delivering impactful technology solutions that support Intel's business operations worldwide. The group focuses on advancing enterprise systems, optimizing IT workflows, and ensuring seamless integration of technologies to enable Intel's continued success and innovation in the marketplace.
The primary responsibilities for this role will include, but are not limited to:
Designs, builds, and integrates applications and platforms to support Intel's business needs and application packaging deployment that meets IT standards.
Collaborate with IT teams to analyze, design, and implement solutions to improve enterprise systems and processes.
Assist in troubleshooting and resolving technical issues to ensure operational efficiency.
Participate in testing and validating IT systems, applications, and processes to support performance reliability.
Contribute to the documentation of system processes and procedures for knowledge sharing and future reference.
Work on assigned projects and tasks, ensuring timely delivery and quality outcomes.
A successful candidate will have proven experience demonstrating the following skills and behavioral traits:
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
Strong communication and collaboration skills to work effectively in a team environment.
Enthusiasm for learning and adapting to new technologies and methodologies.
Ability to manage time effectively and balance multiple tasks or projects in a dynamic environment.
Qualifications:
Minimum Qualifications :
Minimum qualifications are required to be initially considered for this position.
Pursuing a Bachelor's or licenciatura in System Engineering or related fields.
Experience in one or more programming languages such as .NET, MS-SQL, Postgres, Node JS or React, Python, Java, or C++.
Experience in using common software tools or programming languages relevant to IT environments.
Knowledge of the Software Development Lifecycle and/or Test Methodologies.
Knowledge of the Agile Software Development Methodology.
Advanced English level.
Must have unrestricted - permanent right to work in Costa Rica.
Take the next step in your professional journey by applying for this exciting internship opportunity. Join Intel's Global IT team to gain valuable experience, refine your skills, and make an impact in a global organization that thrives on innovation.

Job Details:
Job Description:
The Role and Impact
As an AI Software Engineering PhD Intern, you will contribute to the design, development, and optimization of cutting-edge AI software solutions across domains such as computer vision, machine learning, and deep learning. You will implement and tune AI models for performance and accuracy, explore applied research opportunities, and engage in hardware-software integration to enable scalable and efficient AI solutions. Your work will directly support Intel's technological advancements, giving you hands-on experience to develop skills while contributing to impactful projects in a collaborative environment.
Business group
Intel Foundry is dedicated to delivering world-class manufacturing and technology capabilities that support Intel's mission to create smart, connected systems. The group fosters innovation across hardware and software domains, driving advancements that enable efficient and scalable computing solutions. As part of this group, you will work on initiatives that enhance Intel's ability to deliver transformative products and solutions to customers worldwide.
Key Responsibilities
-Responsible for designing and implementing data-driven solutions that optimize tool capacity management, risk modeling, and defect inspection strategies.
-You will build robust cloud-based ETL pipelines, develop predictive models, deliver actionable insights through published reports and dashboards, and build an MCP server that connects manufacturing data and analytical models to our in house Gen AI and LLM service that empowers engineers to query manufacturing data conversationally.
Qualifications:
You must possess the below minimum qualifications to be initially considered for this position. Preferred qualifications are in addition to the minimum qualifications and are considered a plus factor in identifying top candidates. Experience listed below would be obtained through a combination of your schoolwork, classes, research, relevant previous job, and/or internship experiences.
Minimum Qualifications
o Must be pursuing a PhD in Computer Science, Data Science, AI, Machine Learning, Statistics, or a related discipline.
o 6+months of experience with programing
o 3+ months experience with Git, Docker, Helm, Kubernetes, MCP server
o Proficiency in Python programming and machine learning techniques.
Preferred Qualifications
o Experience with data analysis and visualization.
o Knowledge of statistical analysis and modeling techniques.
o Strong understanding of algorithms, data structures and database fundamentals
We are excited to welcome motivated individuals who are eager to push the boundaries of AI technology. Join us to transform ideas into impactful solutions and grow your career in a supportive, pioneering environment.

intel-jr0288642.text:
Job Details:
Job Description:
The world is transforming - and so is Intel. Intel is a company of bold and curious inventors and problem solvers who create some of the most astounding technology advancements and experiences in the world. With a legacy of relentless innovation and a commitment to bring smart, connected devices to every person on Earth, our diverse and brilliant teams are continually searching for tomorrow's technology and revel in the challenge that changing the world for the better brings. We work every single day to design and manufacture silicon products that empower people's digital lives. Come join us and do something wonderful.
Who we Are:
Intel's Information Security organization enables Intel to provide secure products, solutions, and services which meet U.S. regulatory requirements. The Information Security organization supports the unique IT information Security and Compliance requirements for Intel federal projects that deliver products and/or services to the US Government (USG). As part of this team, you will help us grow our secure solution suite to meet U.S. Government requirements.
The Intel Information Security organization is seeking a Firewall Network Security Engineer. The candidate chosen for this role will assist senior engineers with design, architecture, and build of secure classified network products to support USG operations.
Primary duties and Responsibilities:
• Assist with architecting network and network security products in secured enclaves, including product testing, validation, and selection.
• Assist with design and long-term roadmap planning for new and future scalability in secure enclaves.
• Play a supporting role with the definition of system security requirements, including but not limited to the authorization boundary, security domains, classification of data, etc.
• Assist with design the security interfaces, security interconnections, and the trust relationship between system components and external systems.
• Implement system security designs using commercial-off-the-shelf (COTS), government-off- the-shelf (GOTS), and open-source hardware and software.
• Oversee the hardening and configuration systems and system components in accordance with various Federal, Department of Defense (DoD), and Intelligence Community (IC) guidance.
• Coordinate security assessments to identify security control failures and recommend corrective actions.
#cj
Qualifications:
You must possess the below minimum qualifications to be initially considered for this position. Preferred qualifications are in addition to the minimum requirements and are considered a plus factor in identifying top candidates. Experience listed below would be obtained through a combination of your degree, research and or relevant previous job and or internship experiences.
Minimum Qualifications:
This position requires verification of U.S. citizenship due to citizenship-based legal restrictions. Specifically, this position supports United States government customers and is subject to certain citizenship-based restrictions.
• Ability to obtain an active US Government Security Clearance.
• Bachelor's degree with 3+ years of information technology experience.
• 3+ years of experience:
o Deploying, configuring, Fortinet FortiGate firewalls (FortiOS, VDOMs, High Availability) (preferred)
o Building and deploying FortiManager and FortiAnalyzer in cloud or on premises. (preferred)
o Routing (BGP/OSPF), NAT, and network segmentation, IP address subnetting
o Designing and managing firewall policies, IPS/IDS, and threat controls
Preferred Qualifications:
• Active US Government Top Secret (TS) Security Clearance with the skill to obtain and maintain SCI access.
• Experience with DoD security implementation (e.g. STIG) and security tools for managing the environment.
• Business travel is required as needed.
• Experience with building and managing network infrastructure using automation tools. (Ansible, Python, APIs)
• Integration with SIEM, NAC (ISE), and enterprise network/security tools
• Understanding of NIST/STIG/compliance-driven environments (preferred)
• Develop and maintain operational processes and documentation for ongoing support
• Ability to support security operations: monitoring, analysis, incident response, and vulnerability management
• Experience with network analysis software such as SD Elements, Splunk, Sniffer, Wireshark, or Microsoft Network Monitor.
• Certifications in cybersecurity to include Certified Cloud Security Professional (CCSP) or Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP).
• Experience with scripting in the UNIX environment.
• Experience utilizing Ansible as a configuration management tool, for system administration of users or devices, or as a security compliance automation tool.
• Experience with operational monitoring with SNMP or other Enterprise Network Management Systems
• Familiar with VPN implementation (IPSec, SSL) with identity integration (AD/MFA)
• Experience with troubleshooting tools from CLI, packet capture, and log analysis
Your expertise and innovative thinking are essential for enhancing Intel's security capabilities. Join us to shape the future of secure technology and drive meaningful impact across the industry.
